title: whisper-runpod
one_liner: Containerized Faster Whisper transcription service optimized for RunPod with S3 integration.
what_it_is: A Docker-based solution that deploys a Faster Whisper speech-to-text API server, designed for easy deployment on RunPod.io. It includes utility scripts to fetch audio files from AWS S3 and submit them for transcription via the local API endpoint.
how_its_built: The project uses a Dockerfile to build an image containing the Faster Whisper engine and its dependencies. An entrypoint script manages the server lifecycle, ensuring the API remains active. Shell scripts handle external interactions, specifically downloading assets from S3 using AWS CLI and sending HTTP requests to the transcription endpoint.
how_to_apply: Deploy the built Docker image to a RunPod instance or run it locally. Use the provided shell scripts to automate the workflow of fetching remote audio files from S3 buckets and posting them to the running container's API for text extraction.
quickstart:
docker build -t yourusername/whisper-runpod:latest .
docker push yourusername/whisper-runpod:latest
docker run -p 8000:8000 yourusername/whisper-runpod:latest
curl http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions -F "file=@your-audio-file.mp3" -F "language=en"
features: Runs Faster Whisper model for efficient speech-to-text conversion
Exposes OpenAI-compatible transcription API on port 8000
Includes shell scripts for automated S3 audio retrieval and processing
Designed for seamless deployment on RunPod serverless GPU infrastructure
Monitors and restarts the transcription service via entrypoint logic
